Section 1. Severability of Contract Provisions
In the event that any provision of this Agreement between Tech Innovations LLC and Creative Solutions Inc., dated March 15, 2023, is determined to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, such provision shall be severed from this Agreement. The remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect, provided that the essential terms and conditions of this Agreement for both parties remain intact. Tech Innovations LLC and Creative Solutions Inc. shall negotiate in good faith to replace the invalid provision with a valid and enforceable provision that reflects the original intent as closely as possible and that maintains the balance of obligations and benefits between the parties.

Section 2. Indemnification and Hold Harmless
Effective as of January 1, 2024, XYZ Corporation (hereinafter referred to as 'Indemnitor') agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless ABC Enterprises (hereinafter referred to as 'Indemnitee') from and against any and all claims, liabilities, losses, damages, costs, or expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees) arising out of or in connection with any breach of this Agreement by the Indemnitor or its affiliates. The Indemnitor must provide prompt notice of any claim subject to indemnification and assume the defense thereof at its own expense. This indemnification obligation shall survive the termination of this Agreement and remain in effect until December 31, 2025.

Section 3. Force Majeure Clause
In the event that ABC Manufacturing, Inc. or XYZ Distributors, LLC is unable to perform its obligations under this Agreement due to acts of God, war, terrorism, natural disasters, or any other cause beyond their reasonable control, the affected party shall promptly notify the other party in writing within five (5) business days of the occurrence. The obligations of the affected party shall be suspended for the duration of the force majeure event, and deadlines shall be extended commensurately, provided that performance shall resume as soon as reasonably possible. If the force majeure event continues for a period exceeding ninety (90) days from the initial notification, either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice.

Section 1. Automatic Renewal of Service Agreement
This Agreement between Tech Solutions Inc. ('Provider') and Greenfield Enterprises ('Client') shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms commencing on January 1, 2024, unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior to the expiration of the current term. The Provider must notify the Client of the impending renewal at least 90 days before the expiration date. The Client may opt to terminate the renewal by delivering a written notice of termination to the Provider at least 60 days in advance of the renewal date.

Section 2. Limitation of Liability
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, XYZ Corporation shall not be liable to ABC Limited for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, including but not limited to, loss of revenue, even if XYZ Corporation has been advised of the possibility of such damages. However, XYZ Corporation shall be liable for direct damages up to a maximum aggregate amount of $100,000. This limitation of liability shall apply to all claims, whether arising in contract, tort, or otherwise, and shall survive the termination of this Agreement. This clause shall be effective from the commencement date of this Agreement on January 1, 2024 and shall remain in force until December 31, 2025.

Section 3. Confidentiality Obligations
The parties, Tech Innovations Inc. ("Tech Innovations") and Global Solutions LLC ("Global Solutions"), agree that all confidential information disclosed by either party, in written, oral, or electronic form, on or after November 1, 2023, shall be kept strictly confidential. Tech Innovations must not disclose any proprietary information received from Global Solutions to any third party without prior written consent. Global Solutions may use Tech Innovations' confidential information solely for the purpose of evaluating potential business opportunities between the parties. Both parties must ensure that all confidential information is securely stored and accessible only to employees who need to know such information for the above-stated purpose. These obligations will remain in effect for a period of three (3) years from the termination date of this agreement.

Section 4. Insurance Coverage and Obligations
Party A, hereinafter referred to as 'Insured,' shall obtain and maintain comprehensive general liability insurance from a reputable insurance provider, effective from January 1, 2024, through December 31, 2024. Party B, hereinafter referred to as 'Insurer,' is obligated to provide coverage that includes, but is not limited to, bodily injury, property damage, and personal injury liabilities, with a minimum coverage limit of $1,000,000 per occurrence. The Insured must provide proof of insurance to Party C, hereinafter referred to as 'Beneficiary,' no later than January 10, 2024. Failure to maintain the required insurance coverage shall be considered a breach of contract.

Section 5. Integration and Entire Agreement
This Agreement, entered into by and between Tech Innovators Inc., located at 1234 Innovation Drive, New York, NY, and Green Solutions Ltd., having its principal office at 5678 Greenway Avenue, San Francisco, CA, dated October 15, 2023, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof. As such, it supersedes all prior agreements, representations, and understandings, whether written or oral. No modification or alteration of this Agreement shall be valid unless made in writing and signed by duly authorized representatives of both parties. Each party must ensure compliance with the terms and conditions set forth herein by December 31, 2023. Furthermore, Tech Innovators Inc. must deliver the initial project report by November 30, 2023, and Green Solutions Ltd. may request additional documentation supporting the project outcomes within 15 days of receiving the final report.

Commencing on the 1st day of November, 2023, ABC Corporation (hereinafter referred to as 'Insured') must procure and maintain comprehensive general liability insurance with a minimum coverage of $2,000,000 per occurrence. The insurance policy must be secured from a reputable insurance provider acceptable to XYZ Enterprises (hereinafter referred to as 'Company'). Furthermore, the Insured must provide the Company with a certificate of insurance evidencing such coverage on or before the 15th day of November, 2023. The Insured is also obligated to notify the Company in writing at least 30 days prior to any cancellation or material change in the insurance coverage.

Section 2. Non-Solicitation Clause between TechCorp Inc. and Innovate Solutions LLC
From the date of execution of this Agreement on March 1, 2023, and for a period of two (2) years following the termination of this Agreement, Innovate Solutions LLC agrees not to directly or indirectly solicit, induce, or attempt to solicit or induce any employee, consultant, or contractor of TechCorp Inc. to terminate their relationship with TechCorp Inc. Furthermore, Innovate Solutions LLC shall not engage in any business dealings for the purpose of recruiting or hiring any such individual for employment or consultancy with Innovate Solutions LLC or any affiliated entity. Failure to comply with this clause will result in significant legal repercussions as determined by applicable law.

Section 3. Comprehensive Agreement Clause
This Agreement, entered into by and between AlphaTech Innovations, Inc. ('AlphaTech') and Gamma Solutions, LLC ('Gamma Solutions') on March 15, 2023, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, negotiations, and discussions, whether oral or written. Neither party shall have any obligations or liabilities with respect to such prior agreements once this Agreement takes effect. Any amendments or modifications to this Agreement must be in writing and signed by both parties. AlphaTech must provide the final deliverables to Gamma Solutions by June 30, 2023. Gamma Solutions must remit payment to AlphaTech within 30 days of receiving the final deliverables.

Section 4. Intellectual Property Rights and Obligations
As of the Effective Date of this Agreement, October 15, 2023, all intellectual property created, developed, or conceived under this Agreement by Tech Innovations Ltd. (hereinafter 'Developer') shall be the sole and exclusive property of Blue Horizon Enterprises Inc. (hereinafter 'Client'). The Developer must assign and transfer all rights, titles, and interests in any inventions, patents, copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property to the Client no later than December 31, 2023. The Developer must not use any of the intellectual property for any purpose other than as expressly permitted by the Client in writing. The Client may use, modify, and distribute the intellectual property without any restriction.

Section 1. Automatic Renewal of Service Agreement
This Agreement between AlphaTech Solutions, Inc. ("AlphaTech") and BetaCorp Enterprises ("BetaCorp") shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms commencing on January 1, 2024, unless either party provides written notice of intent not to renew at least 60 days prior to the end of the current term. AlphaTech must notify BetaCorp of any changes to terms and conditions at least 90 days before the renewal date. BetaCorp, upon receipt of such notice, may elect to terminate the agreement before renewal by providing written notice to AlphaTech within 30 days of receiving the changes.

Section 2. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This Agreement, entered into on September 15, 2023, by and between Alpha Corp., a corporation organized under the laws of Delaware, and Beta Innovations LLC, a limited liability company registered in California, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of law principles. Alpha Corp. must ensure compliance with all relevant New York state regulations by December 31, 2023. Beta Innovations LLC may consult with legal counsel to interpret this clause. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in New York County, New York.

Section 3. Non-Solicitation of Employees and Clients
ABC Corporation (hereinafter referred to as 'Employer') and John Doe (hereinafter referred to as 'Employee') agree that for a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of Employee's employment with Employer, regardless of the reason for termination, Employee shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit, recruit, or hire any employees of Employer for employment with any other business or entity. Furthermore, Employee agrees not to solicit or entice away any clients or customers of Employer with whom Employee had contact or dealings during the last twelve (12) months of their employment. This obligation shall commence upon the termination date, which is agreed to be October 15, 2023.

Section 4. Dispute Resolution and Mediation
In the event of any dispute arising between Alpha Corp ("Alpha") and Beta Solutions LLC ("Beta") concerning the interpretation or performance of this Agreement dated January 15, 2023, both parties agree to first attempt to resolve the dispute through good faith negotiation. If the parties are unable to resolve the dispute within 30 days from the date the dispute arises, they shall submit the matter to mediation before a mutually agreed-upon mediator. The mediation shall commence no later than 45 days from the date the dispute was first notified by either party. Should mediation fail, the parties agree that the dispute shall be finally resolved by arbitration conducted in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association, with the arbitration proceeding to occur no later than 90 days from the date that mediation was deemed unsuccessful.

Section 5. Intellectual Property Rights and Obligations
As of January 1, 2024, ABC Tech Solutions, LLC (hereinafter referred to as 'ABC') shall retain exclusive ownership of all intellectual property, including but not limited to patents, copyrights, trademarks, and trade secrets, developed or created during the term of this Agreement. XYZ Innovations Corp. (hereinafter referred to as 'XYZ') agrees to assign any rights, title, and interest it may acquire in such intellectual property to ABC, effective immediately upon creation. XYZ must ensure that all intellectual property developed under this Agreement is disclosed to ABC within ten (10) business days of creation. Furthermore, XYZ may not use, reproduce, or distribute any such intellectual property without the prior written consent of ABC.

Beta LLC must take all reasonable steps to mitigate the impact of the force majeure event on its obligations. If the force majeure event continues for a period exceeding thirty (30) days from November 1, 2023, either party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the other party without any liability.

Section 1. Data Protection and Privacy Obligations
XYZ Corporation (hereinafter referred to as 'XYZ') and ABC Enterprises (hereinafter referred to as 'ABC') agree to adhere to the following data privacy obligations effective from November 1, 2023. XYZ shall ensure that all personal data collected from ABC is processed in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws. XYZ must implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect ABC's personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction by December 31, 2023. Furthermore, ABC may request access to its personal data held by XYZ at any time, and XYZ must respond to such requests within 30 days of receipt.

Section 2. Non-Compete Agreement
In consideration of employment with Tech Innovations LLC (hereinafter 'Employer'), John Doe (hereinafter 'Employee') agrees that for a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of his employment, whether voluntary or involuntary, the Employee shall not engage in, manage, operate, or be employed by any business that competes directly with the Employer's business within a fifty (50) mile radius of the Employer's primary place of business located at 123 Innovation Drive, Tech City, State. Furthermore, the Employee must not solicit any of the Employer's clients, defined as any individual or entity that has conducted business with the Employer in the twelve (12) months preceding the Employee's termination. This clause shall become effective on the date of termination of employment and shall remain in force until the aforementioned twelve (12) month period has expired.

Section 3. Intellectual Property Rights and Obligations
The intellectual property created under this Agreement between Innovatech Solutions, Inc. and Creative Minds LLC, dated January 15, 2024, shall be owned exclusively by Innovatech Solutions, Inc. Creative Minds LLC must assign any and all rights, titles, and interests in any inventions, discoveries, or work products developed in the performance of this Agreement to Innovatech Solutions, Inc. within 30 days of creation. Furthermore, Creative Minds LLC must not use any of Innovatech Solutions, Inc.'s intellectual property for any purposes outside the scope of this Agreement without prior written consent from Innovatech Solutions, Inc.

Section 4. Insurance Obligations for Project Completion
ABC Construction, Inc. (hereinafter referred to as 'Contractor') shall procure and maintain, at its own expense, a comprehensive general liability insurance policy with coverage limits not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence, effective from January 1, 2024, to December 31, 2024. Contractor shall provide XYZ Real Estate Group (hereinafter referred to as 'Owner') with a certificate of insurance evidencing such coverage no later than January 15, 2024. The Owner must be listed as an additional insured on the policy for the duration of the project. In the event of policy cancellation or modification, the Contractor must notify the Owner at least 30 days prior to such change.

Section 5. Entire Agreement Clause
This Agreement, effective as of January 1, 2024, by and between Apex Technologies, Inc., a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Delaware, and Bright Solutions LLC, a limited liability company established under the laws of the State of California, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter hereof. It supersedes all prior or contemporaneous negotiations, discussions, agreements, or understandings, whether written or oral. Each party acknowledges that they have not relied upon any representations, promises, or agreements of any kind other than those expressly set forth herein. Apex Technologies, Inc. shall provide the final deliverables as specified in Exhibit A by December 31, 2024. Bright Solutions LLC must submit all project feedback within 15 business days of receipt of each deliverable. No supplement, modification, or waiver of this Agreement shall be deemed valid unless executed in writing by both parties.

Both parties shall use all reasonable efforts to mitigate the effects of the force majeure event and resume performance of their obligations as soon as feasible.

('AlphaTech') and Beta Innovations, LLC ('Beta Innovations'), the parties agree to first engage in good faith negotiations to resolve the dispute. If mediation does not resolve the dispute within fifteen (15) days from the mediation commencement date, either party may initiate arbitration proceedings. The arbitration shall be conducted in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association and must commence no later than sixty (60) days following the conclusion of mediation.

In the event that either Party, namely Global Tech Solutions, Inc. The affected Party must notify the other Party in writing within ten (10) days of the occurrence of the Force Majeure Event, outlining the nature of the event and its expected impact on performance. Global Tech must resume performance of its obligations as soon as reasonably possible following the cessation of the Force Majeure Event and is required to make reasonable efforts to mitigate any delays caused thereby.

Section 3. Automatic Renewal of Service Agreement
This Agreement between AlphaTech Solutions, Inc. ('Provider') and BetaCorp Enterprises ('Client') shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms commencing on January 1, 2024, unless either party provides written notice of their intent not to renew at least 60 days prior to the expiration of the current term. Section 1. Amendment to Service Agreement
This Amendment to the Service Agreement (the 'Agreement') dated March 15, 2023, is made and entered into between Alpha Tech Solutions, Inc., with its principal place of business at 1234 Innovation Drive, Tech City, State 56789 ('Alpha Tech'), and Beta Enterprises, LLC, located at 5678 Business Blvd, Suite 101, Market Town, State 12345 ('Beta Enterprises'). This Amendment is effective as of November 1, 2023. The parties agree to amend the Agreement as follows: 1. Alpha Tech shall extend the delivery timeline for the software development project from December 31, 2023, to February 28, 2024. 2. Beta Enterprises must provide all necessary project specifications by November 15, 2023. 3. Alpha Tech may request additional resources from Beta Enterprises if unforeseen challenges arise, subject to mutual agreement. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement shall remain in full force and effect.

Section 2. Rights and Obligations Assignment
Effective as of November 15, 2023, XYZ Corporation ('Assignor') hereby assigns all of its rights, title, and interest in the Software Development Agreement dated January 10, 2023, to ABC Enterprises, Inc. ('Assignee'). The Assignor must provide the Assignee with all relevant documentation and access to necessary resources related to the Software Development Agreement by no later than November 30, 2023. The Assignee must acknowledge receipt of such documentation and resources in writing within five business days of receipt. Any assignment by the Assignor shall be subject to the prior written consent of the Assignee, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

Section 3. Insurance Coverage and Obligations
ABC Enterprises, Inc. (hereinafter referred to as 'ABC') shall procure and maintain, at its sole expense, comprehensive general liability insurance and workers' compensation insurance with respect to its operations under this Agreement. Such insurance shall be provided by an insurer reasonably acceptable to XYZ Corporation (hereinafter referred to as 'XYZ') and shall include XYZ as an additional insured. ABC shall deliver certificates of insurance evidencing the required coverage to XYZ no later than January 15, 2024. The insurance policies shall include a provision that requires the insurer to provide at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to XYZ before any cancellation or modification of coverage.

Section 4. Non-Solicitation of Employees
During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months following its termination or expiration, neither Tech Innovations Inc. nor Global Solutions LLC shall, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or employ any person who is or was an employee of the other party during the six (6) months preceding the date of termination of this Agreement. This restriction shall not apply to general advertisements not specifically targeted at employees of the other party.

Section 5. Dispute Resolution and Arbitration
In the event of any dispute arising between Alpha Technologies LLC and Beta Innovations Inc. related to this Agreement, both parties agree to first attempt to resolve the dispute through good faith negotiations to be commenced within thirty (30) days of either party providing written notice of such dispute. If the dispute is not resolved through negotiation, the parties agree to submit the matter to binding arbitration under the rules of the American Arbitration Association to be held in New York, NY. The arbitration must be initiated within ninety (90) days following the conclusion of the negotiation period. Any decision resulting from such arbitration shall be deemed final and enforceable in any court of competent jurisdiction.

Section 3. Data Privacy and Protection Obligations
The parties, TechCorp Inc. ('TechCorp') and Secure Solutions LLC ('Secure Solutions'), hereby agree to comply with the following data privacy and protection obligations, effective as of January 1, 2024. Secure Solutions must not disclose any personal data received from TechCorp to third parties without prior written consent, except as required by law. Both parties may audit each other's compliance with these obligations upon providing thirty (30) days written notice, but no more frequently than once per calendar year.

Section 5. Intellectual Property Rights and Obligations

Design Solutions must ensure that any deliverables provided to Tech Innovations by June 30, 2023, do not infringe upon the intellectual property rights of any third party.
